info.title: OpenDefence MediaMTX Integration API
info.summary: Resource API for MediaMTX streams, scoped grants and client profiles.
info.description: Design contract for opendefence/integration-mediamtx. This file describes the proposed replacement API, not the deployed legacy service. Core owns identities and effective permissions. Integration account metadata belongs in UserBinding.status. Namespace-scoped Kubernetes Secrets hold credential material and bounded grant records. No user database is required. Callsigns are mutable display metadata. Public requests use verified client mTLS and Core authorization. Media credentials cannot authenticate to this REST API. Core UI session and workload alternatives remain design gates. Identity headers are internal trust-boundary data, not client authentication parameters. All public responses use Cache-Control: no-store. This draft exports the plan for contract review. It is not generated from a running implementation.

get.description: The response advertises tested protocols, profile formats and limits. It does not contain credentials.
Core resolves the authenticated principal. This endpoint does not create a User, binding, path or credential.
List declared destinations and currently observed channels that the caller can access. Use MediaMTX ready state for live status. A failed observation returns 503, not an empty list.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Omit to include both live and offline streams.

get.description: Decode and validate the canonical path. Resolve current ownership and policy. This response contains no credential-bearing URLs.
By default, return only the caller's grants. scope=all requires an explicit management permission. Retained tombstones are included unless filtered. No secret values are returned.

post.description: Authorize the exact stream, action, protocol set and expiry against fresh Core policy. The server assigns the owner. Create the Secret atomically with a name derived from the principal and idempotency-key digest. Store a normalized request digest. A matching retry returns this resource; a different payload returns 409. Recheck current caller access on every retry. Retain the idempotency record for the advertised retry window. A created grant can remain pending until reconciliation completes.

201.description: The grant resource exists. Its state reports reconciliation readiness.

get.description: Return scope, expiry and cleanup state. Revoked or expired resources remain visible during the documented retention period. Grant IDs do not authorize access.

delete.summary: Revoke a grant and remove its sessions
delete.description: Persist denial before disconnecting current sessions. Return 202 while cleanup is pending or failed. The response body exposes cleanup state; denial remains active. Return 204 after session removal is confirmed. Repeated authorized calls remain safe. A stale If-Match still returns 412. Keep a tombstone until the retry and cleanup retention requirements are met.

202.description: Revocation is durable. Session cleanup is incomplete.

204.description: Revocation and session removal are complete. No response body.

get.summary: Get a connection profile or client file
get.description: Authorize retrieval on every request. Require a ready, active, unexpired grant and fresh Core access. GET never issues, rotates or changes credentials. Expired or revoked grants return 409 with grant-unavailable; pending grants use grant-not-ready. Dependency outages return 503. The profile and protocol must be advertised in capabilities and match the grant's action and scope. XML and playlists are returned as attachments. Application-specific setup profiles return JSON. A UAS Tool publishing profile requires observerGrantId for a separate ready read grant on the same stream. Authorize both grants and cap profile expiry at their earliest deadline. Its observer protocol is RTMPS. Reject invalid combinations with 422. Unsupported Accept media types return 406.

200.description: Requested profile. connection-json, opentak-icu, gopro and uas-tool return JSON. atak-video-xml returns XML. vlc-m3u returns a playlist.

schema.description: TAK video-feed XML. Requires profile=atak-video-xml and a read grant with a tested protocol.
UTF-8 VLC playlist. Requires profile=vlc-m3u and a read grant with a tested protocol.

parameters.name: protocol
parameters.description: Select one protocol authorized by this grant and supported by the requested profile.

parameters.name: observerGrantId
parameters.description: Required for a UAS Tool publishing profile. It must permit RTMPS read on the same stream. Reject this parameter for other profiles.

servers.description: Private callback Service. Never expose this route through the public API ingress.

serviceHost.description: Configured internal Service DNS name. Verify the server certificate.

post.summary: Evaluate an upstream MediaMTX authorization request
post.description: MediaMTX calls this endpoint before a media action. This route uses a separate private listener. Network policy limits callers and verified TLS protects transport. The upstream client does not authenticate through Core user mTLS. Empty OpenAPI security does not make the route publicly accessible. Allow only explicit grants or narrowly scoped control credentials. Deny stale policy, revoked owners and expired grants. Do not treat an allowed callback as proof of successful connection or certificate activation. This endpoint preserves the upstream contract rather than the public Problem Details format.

204.description: The requested action is allowed. Empty body.

400.description: Malformed payload. Empty body; fail closed.

401.description: Credentials are missing. MediaMTX can challenge the client. Empty body.

403.description: Credentials, scope, owner state, action or protocol are denied. Empty body.

413.description: The payload exceeds the configured limit. Empty body.

422.description: Payload validation failed. Empty body; do not echo request values.

429.description: Callback capacity or request limit exceeded. Empty body; fail closed.

503.description: Required policy or credential data is unavailable or stale. Empty body; fail closed.

ClientCertificate.description: Core owns public user mTLS authentication and any ForwardAuth configuration. The integration consumes Core's injected user UUID header, default X-OpenDefence-User-UUID (configurable). Require one canonical UUID text or compact Base64URL value. Core's edge removes client-supplied identity headers and prevents alternate ingress. The integration does not parse certificates or implement ForwardAuth.

OpaqueId.description: Stable opaque identifier. Do not derive identity from a callsign.

StreamId.description: Versioned Base64URL encoding of a canonical media path, without padding. Decode and authorize the path separately.

GrantId.description: Opaque grant identifier. Each replacement grant has a new identifier.

MediaProtocol.description: Public protocol name. Only deployment-enabled and tested protocols are advertised.

MediaAction.description: A media action. This value cannot authorize api, metrics or pprof. Archive playback remains disabled until its deployment and client contract is verified.

ProfileId.description: Client profile format. A deployment advertises only verified profiles.

requiresObserverGrant.description: True for a publishing profile that also delivers an observer configuration.

strictOutageEnforcementVerified.description: True only after the selected deployment passes the strict outage tests.

callsign.description: Observed display name. It is not an account key.

mediaPath.description: Canonical destination. This path does not contain a credential.

callsign.description: Current Core display name. A change does not change stream or grant identifiers.

accessExpiresAt.description: Absolute approval deadline, when the Core profile supplies one. Grant expiry cannot exceed this deadline.

displayName.description: Display label. This value may change with the owner's callsign.

mediaPath.description: Canonical media path. Validate owner and complete segments; never use a bare prefix match.

state.description: live requires a current MediaMTX ready observation. Missing upstream data is not offline.

observedAt.description: Time of the current successful MediaMTX observation.

nextCursor.description: Omit this field on the last page.

actions.description: The first version grants exactly one action on one exact stream.

expiresAt.description: Must be in the future. It cannot exceed the Core approval deadline or the advertised lifetime limit.

label.description: Human-readable purpose. Do not include secrets.

CreateAccessGrant.description: The server chooses the owner and credential. The request cannot set a username, password, owner or administrative permission.

revokedAt.description: Present after explicit revocation. Expiry does not require this field.

cleanupState.description: Tracks removal of existing sessions. Denial remains active if cleanup fails.

AccessGrant.description: Secret-free grant metadata. Kubernetes Secret references and credential values are not exposed here.

nextCursor.description: Omit this field on the last page.

username.description: Unique media username for this grant generation. It is not the callsign.

password.description: Secret credential. Never log or cache this value.

placement.description: How the selected native protocol carries credentials.

streamId.description: Complete, escaped-as-required Stream ID. This value contains credentials.

passphrase.description: Path-level encryption passphrase for this action. It is separate from the grant password.

endpoint.description: Configured endpoint without credentials. It is not inferred from an untrusted Host header.

connectionUrl.description: Complete native-client URL. This value can contain secrets. Never supply this field for HLS or WebRTC.

expiresAt.description: Earliest expiry across the delivered grants and the current approval deadline.

connections.description: The primary grant comes first. An optional second connection uses the separate observer grant.

clientSetupUri.description: Optional application-specific setup URI. It can contain both credentials. Do not log, cache or persist it in binding status.

ConnectionProfile.description: Secret-bearing response. Authorize delivery each time. Downloading this representation does not prove successful client installation.

Problem.description: Problem Details for the public API. Do not include credentials, Secret names or upstream request bodies.

instance.description: Request instance identifier. It must not contain query credentials.

message.description: Validation error without the rejected secret value.

MediaMTXAuthRequest.description: Upstream MediaMTX v1.21.2 HTTP authorization payload. Ignore unknown fields. Unknown actions or protocols are denied. Do not log the body.

user.description: Media grant username, or an explicitly scoped control/monitoring username.

token.description: May duplicate password in this upstream version. Token-only media access is not enabled by this draft.

ip.description: Client IP as observed by MediaMTX. It is not an identity proof.

action.description: Known actions: publish, read, playback, api, metrics and pprof. Disable pprof in the deployment.

path.description: Canonical stream path, or an empty string for an administrative action.

protocol.description: Upstream names include rtsp, rtmp, hls, webrtc, srt and moq. RTSPS reports rtsp and RTMPS reports rtmp; the callback cannot attest TLS. Map these to secure public protocols only with verified strict listener configuration. Deny protocols that the deployment does not support.

id.description: Upstream session or connection ID. It can be absent or null. Callback success is not connection proof.

query.description: Raw query string. It can contain credentials. Never log this value.

x-core-identity-header.requirement: Exactly one Core-injected canonical UUID; preserve and reject duplicate headers. The edge strips client values and the integration listener is restricted to the trusted route. This header is not a public authentication parameter.

x-design-gates.decision: TAK profiles and cross-repository integration are deferred until the related sibling repository tasks are complete. Do not advertise TAK capabilities before then.

The supplied platform.opendefence.fi/v1alpha1 CRD defines integration-created userRef bindings and integration-owned Synced status. Status only permits conditions and observedGeneration. Effective-policy projection and identity restore remain open; bindings are provisioning observations, not assignments.

Core owns user mTLS and any ForwardAuth implementation. The integration's UUID header parser defaults to X-OpenDefence-User-UUID and supports a configured name. Verify header stripping and trusted-only ingress at deployment. UI session and workload authentication alternatives remain open.
Agree how Core proves policy freshness and the absolute approval deadline.
M1 reproduced a broken HLS redirect with Traefik StripPrefix. Keep the prefix route gated until base approves and tests response Location rewriting or another explicit routing contract.

M1 verified paginated HLS session removal and found that callback outage leaves existing HLS sessions readable while denying control calls. Strict outage enforcement remains unverified. Complete other protocol, Core and operator fault tests.
Agree explicit self-use versus sharing purpose and its authorization before implementing issuance. A free-text label is not an authorization input, and any bearer credential can be copied.
Advertise a client profile only after real import, update and playback tests pass.

x-profile-constraints.connection-json: Any enabled media action/protocol combination that the grant and runtime support.
x-profile-constraints.atak-video-xml: Read only. Start with RTMPS; expand only after client tests.
x-profile-constraints.vlc-m3u: Read only. Start with HLS and SRT; expand only after client tests.
x-profile-constraints.opentak-icu: Publish only. Select a protocol proven with the supported ICU version.
x-profile-constraints.uas-tool: Publish over SRT with a separate same-stream RTMPS read grant in observerGrantId.

x-storage-contract.integrationMetadata: Integration-owned UserBinding.status.conditions and observedGeneration only; resolve identity/display data from Core User and store grant/policy metadata in bounded namespace Secrets.
x-storage-contract.bindingWrites: Integration creates one platform.opendefence.fi/v1alpha1 UserBinding per User in its own namespace with spec.userRef.name; Core observes these bindings.
x-storage-contract.credentials: Namespace-scoped Secrets; never in binding status
x-storage-contract.grantWrites: API creates and revokes grant Secrets with atomic create and resource-version preconditions.
x-storage-contract.statusWrites: Operator is the sole integration status writer.
x-storage-contract.currentSessions: Read from MediaMTX; bounded in-memory observations only.
